categories.name: STM32 Board & Shared I2C Bring-up
categories.description: Covers controller and power setup plus the shared I2C bus connections and transaction coordination required before peripheral services run.
requirements: The system shall use an STM32-NUCLEO-G070RB development board.
The system shall receive 5 V power via micro-USB from a 12 V automotive adapter.
The system shall prevent overlapping transactions on the shared PB8/PB9 communication bus from interfering with MPU6050 or OLED communications.
The MPU6050 and OLED SCL pins shall both connect to PB8.
The MPU6050 and OLED SDA pins shall both connect to PB9.

categories.name: DHT22 Climate Sensing
categories.description: Covers DHT22 hardware integration and periodic temperature and humidity acquisition.
requirements: The system shall include a DHT22 climate sensor for temperature and humidity.
The DHT22 VCC shall connect to the STM32-NUCLEO-G070RB 3.3 V pin.
The DHT22 GND shall connect to GND.
The DHT22 OUT shall connect to STM32 pin PB4.
The system shall read temperature in degrees Celsius from the DHT22 every 2 seconds.
The system shall read humidity in percent from the DHT22 every 2 seconds.

categories.name: MPU6050 Motion Sensing & Event Detection
categories.description: Covers MPU6050 integration, acceleration setup and calibration, axis interpretation, sudden-change detection, and cabin/ride data acquisition for dashboard use.
requirements: The system shall include an MPU6050 IMU with a 3-axis accelerometer and gyroscope.
The MPU6050 VCC shall connect to the STM32-NUCLEO-G070RB 3.3 V pin.
The MPU6050 GND shall connect to GND.
The system shall monitor interior cabin climate and vehicle ride dynamics using the STM32-NUCLEO-G070RB.
The system shall read the MPU6050 X, Y, and Z acceleration axes at a ±4 g range and a 100 Hz rate.
The system shall convert MPU6050 acceleration readings to G-force.
At power-up, the system shall keep the board flat and still for 1 second while zeroing the acceleration readings to X = 0 g, Y = 0 g, and Z = 1 g.
The system shall map the X acceleration axis to lateral motion (cornering).
The system shall map the Y acceleration axis to longitudinal motion (acceleration/braking).
The system shall map the Z acceleration axis to vertical motion (bumps).
The system shall display "Unseen SpeedBreaker" when the Z-axis changes suddenly by 0.30 g or more.
The system shall display "Wide Turn" when the X-axis changes suddenly by 0.25 g or more.
The system shall display "Speeding" when the Y-axis changes suddenly by +0.25 g or more.
The system shall display "Sudden Braking" when the Y-axis changes suddenly by the stated 0.25 g threshold or more.
Before acquiring acceleration data, the system shall configure the MPU6050 to provide readings using the specified ±4 g range and 100 Hz sampling rate.
The system shall not evaluate sudden-change event thresholds until the 1-second power-up acceleration calibration is complete.
The system shall classify an axis value change as sudden when it reaches or exceeds the applicable threshold within a 100 ms detection window.
For the stated expected use, the system shall stream cabin comfort and ride data to a dashboard for driver-behavior review or ride-comfort tracking.

categories.name: Alert Configuration & LED Signaling
categories.description: Covers configurable climate and motion alert limits and LD4 event indication behavior.
requirements: The built-in user LED LD4 shall be connected to PA5.
The system shall make all alert thresholds configurable as macros in config.h.
When any of the four specified events occurs, the system shall blink the built-in LED LD4 with a 500 ms on interval and a 500 ms off interval.
For the demo threshold, the system shall use 32 degC as the temperature-high limit.
For the demo threshold, the system shall use 75% as the humidity-high limit.
For in-vehicle use, the system shall use G thresholds raised to about 0.4 to 0.5 g.
For in-vehicle use, the system shall use a temperature limit of 45 degC.
For in-vehicle use, the system shall use a humidity limit of 80%.
The event message and LED blinking shall continue for 2 seconds after the last event.

categories.name: OLED Display & Alert Rendering
categories.description: Covers SH1106 OLED integration and rendering of the dashboard headings, climate and motion values, threshold markers, and prioritized event messages.
requirements: The system shall include a 1.3-inch OLED display using the SH1106 driver.
The OLED VDD shall connect to the STM32-NUCLEO-G070RB 3.3 V pin.
The OLED GND shall connect to GND.
The system shall print the monitored data on the OLED display.
The OLED shall display the heading "Vehicle Parameters Display".
When any of the four specified events occurs, the system shall show the event message immediately on the OLED while keeping the temperature and humidity values visible.
When specified events overlap, the system shall apply this message priority, highest first: Sudden Braking, Unseen SpeedBreaker, Wide Turn, Speeding.
If temperature goes above its limit, the system shall show "!" next to the temperature value.
If humidity goes above its limit, the system shall show "!" next to the humidity value.
The OLED shall display the heading as "Vehicle Parameters" and "Display" on separate lines, as shown in the OLED display format.
The OLED display format shall include the temperature value from the DHT22 followed by the unit degC and the label "Temp:".
The OLED display format shall include the humidity value from the DHT22 followed by the unit % and the label "Humidity:".
The OLED display format shall include the X-axis acceleration value with the label "X:".
The OLED display format shall include the Y-axis acceleration value with the label "Y:".
The OLED display format shall include the Z-axis acceleration value with the label "Z:" and unit g.
